initial_question: Can we estimate a stimulation-associated change in expression separately from capture for each of the two candidate populations?
revision_rule: Withhold a population that misses the complete-pair floor. If capture and condition are inseparable, withhold the capture-adjusted contrast and fit only an exploratory observed-preparation association in the supported population. Apply the rule before looking at gene-level estimates.
requirements_source: The paired donor design and source captures come from the study. The two populations, support floor, count filter, and reporting rule were fixed by the walkthrough author before fitting.
